caption: The drawing depicts a lidded, cup-shaped urn or vessel placed on a shallow, circular dish. The vessel has a wide base that tapers upwards into a narrow stem, then flares outward to form the bowl, and is topped with a dome-shaped lid that has a central knob or finial. All the objects are rendered in grayscale pencil shading, giving them a metallic or stone-like appearance. The dish is flat with a slightly upturned rim, matching the width of the vessel at its widest part. The primary, larger drawing is enclosed in a rectangular border situated in the lower center area of the page, with the signature "M. Mangiacotti" in the bottom right corner of this rectangle. In the upper left corner of the main rectangle, there is a smaller inset drawing that shows a simplified version of the same lidded vessel and dish, along with measurements indicating the height and width: 4 5/16 inches tall and 3 9/16 inches wide. The background is plain, off-white paper with some yellowing around the edges.
title: Lamp
